subject: Go-live readiness: kickoff scheduling and owner matrix
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@northshorehealth.com>, Carlos Rios <c.rios@northshorehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Subject: Go-live readiness: kickoff scheduling and owner matrix

Hi Alice / Carlos,

Hope youre both well. Were ready to schedule the formal kickoff to align on go-live readiness for the Northshore rollout. This meeting will cover success criteria, dependencies, and who owns each prep item so we have a single source of truth during implementation.

Proposed slots (please indicate all that work for your team):
- Tue, Jun 14 — 10:0011:00 AM ET (preferred by our delivery team)
- Wed, Jun 15 — 2:003:00 PM ET
- Thu, Jun 16 — 9:0010:00 AM ET

Suggested agenda (high-level):
- Introductions and roles (10m)
- Scope and success criteria (15m)
- Owner matrix review (15m)
- Open issues / dependencies (15m)
- Next steps and timeline (10m)

Action items for your side before the meeting: share primary admin + security contact and any calendar conflicts. From our side well draft an owner matrix and attach a focused agenda.

If none of these slots work, propose 2 alternatives and well triage.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@northshorehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Go-live readiness: kickoff scheduling and owner matrix

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the options. Our preference is Tue, Jun 14 10:0011:00 AM ET. That works for our PM (Nina) and the security lead (Carlos). If you need it to be a 90-minute deep-dive, we can extend but would prefer one hour initially.

Please send the agenda and attendee list so we can confirm internally. Also, our compliance team would like a note on what artifacts youll share (SOC2 evidence, data flow diagram) so they can surface any questions ahead of time.

Cheers,
Alice Morgan
Director, Digital Delivery
Northshore Health
